   204	def _parse_events(value, flows_by_id):
   205	    if value.__class__ is not list:
   206	        raise Bad("events not list")
   207	    if len(value) > 20000:
   208	        raise Bad("events size")
   209	    events = []
   210	    total = 0
   211	    for ev in value:
   212	        if ev.__class__ is not dict:
   213	            raise Bad("event not object")
   214	        op = ev.get("op")
   215	        if op.__class__ is not str:
   216	            raise Bad("event op")
   217	        if op == "packet":
   218	            if set(ev) != {"op", "flow", "header", "payload"}:
   219	                raise Bad("packet keys")
   220	            fid = ev["flow"]
   221	            if fid.__class__ is not str or fid not in flows_by_id:
   222	                raise Bad("packet flow")
   223	            fl = flows_by_id[fid]
   224	            header = _hex_bytes(ev["header"])
   225	            if len(header) != fl.H:
   226	                raise Bad("packet header size")
   227	            payload = _hex_bytes(ev["payload"])
   228	            if len(payload) > 2048:
   229	                raise Bad("packet payload size")
   230	            total += len(header) + len(payload)
   231	            if total > _MAX_PACKET_BYTES:
   232	                raise Bad("packet bytes budget")
   233	            events.append(("packet", fl, header, payload))
   234	        elif op == "put":
   235	            if set(ev) != {"op", "flow", "node"}:
   236	                raise Bad("put keys")
   237	            fid = ev["flow"]
   238	            if fid.__class__ is not str or fid not in flows_by_id:
   239	                raise Bad("put flow")
   240	            fl = flows_by_id[fid]
   241	            node = ev["node"]
   242	            if node.__class__ is not str or node not in fl.nodeset:
   243	                raise Bad("put node")
   244	            events.append(("put", fl, node))
   245	        elif op == "enable" or op == "disable":
   246	            if set(ev) != {"op", "flow"}:
   247	                raise Bad("control keys")
   248	            fid = ev["flow"]
   249	            if fid.__class__ is not str or fid not in flows_by_id:
   250	                raise Bad("control flow")
   251	            events.append((op, flows_by_id[fid], None))
   252	        elif op == "reset":
   253	            if set(ev) != {"op"}:
   254	                raise Bad("reset keys")
   255	            events.append(("reset", None, None))
   256	        else:
   257	            raise Bad("unknown op")
   258	    return events

   261	def _packet_result(fl, header, payload, enabled):
   262	    if not enabled:
   263	        mode = "ip"
   264	        reason = "disabled"
   265	    else:
   266	        hval = int.from_bytes(header, "big")
   267	        if (hval & fl.kmask) != fl.tmplm:
   268	            mode = "ip"
   269	            reason = "mismatch"
   270	        elif header[fl.qpos] > 7:
   271	            mode = "ip"
   272	            reason = "qos"
   273	        else:
   274	            mode = "mpls"
   275	            reason = "compressed"
   276	
   277	    ttl = header[fl.tpos]
   278	    nlinks = fl.N
   279	    if ttl:
   280	        if ttl > nlinks:
   281	            links = nlinks
   282	        else:
   283	            links = ttl
   284	    else:
   285	        links = 0
   286	    plen = len(payload)
   287	
   288	    if mode == "ip":
   289	        payload_hex = payload.hex()
   290	        header_hex = header.hex()
   291	        cut = fl.tpos * 2
   292	        pre = header_hex[:cut]
   293	        post = header_hex[cut + 2:]
   294	        wire = [pre + "%02x" % (ttl - i) + post + payload_hex
   295	                for i in range(links)]
   296	        hops = links * (fl.H + plen)
   297	        delivered = wire[-1] if links == nlinks else None
   298	    else:
   299	        tc = header[fl.qpos]
   300	        if fl.nd == 0:
   301	            residue = b""
   302	        elif fl.nd == 1:
   303	            residue = header[fl.dpos0:fl.dpos0 + 1]
   304	        else:
   305	            residue = bytes(fl.dget(header))
   306	        residue_hex = residue.hex()
   307	        payload_hex = payload.hex()
   308	        labelwords = fl.labelwords
   309	        tc9 = tc << 9
   310	        wire = []
   311	        push = wire.append
   312	        for i in range(links):
   313	            push("%08x" % (labelwords[i] | tc9 | 0x100 | (ttl - i))
   314	                 + residue_hex + payload_hex)
   315	        hops = links * (4 + fl.nd + plen)
   316	        if links == nlinks:
   317	            out = bytearray(fl.tmpl)
   318	            dpos = fl.dpos
   319	            for k in range(fl.nd):
   320	                out[dpos[k]] = residue[k]
   321	            for pos in fl.zpos:
   322	                out[pos] = 0
   323	            out[fl.qpos] = tc
   324	            out[fl.tpos] = ttl - fl.h
   325	            delivered = (bytes(out) + payload).hex()
   326	        else:
   327	            delivered = None
   328	    return {"mode": mode, "reason": reason, "wire": wire,
   329	            "delivered": delivered, "byte_hops": hops}
